content: From untruth lead me to truth; from darkness lead me to light; from death lead me to immortality.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Asato ma sadgamaya (असतो मा सद्गमय) — Brihadaranyaka Upanishad I.3.28
explanation: This primordial prayer of humanity strips away all transactional requests for wealth, health, and victory. It asks only for the essential pilgrimage of consciousness: to step out of the illusions of the ego into the eternal sunlight of truth.
practicalInsight: Breathe this ancient mantra silently before you begin work today: 'Lead me from illusion to reality, from darkness to light.'
reflectionPrompt: What petty worldly distractions are obscuring your fundamental quest for truth and light?
